name: Synbio Orders API
description:
API for submitting and managing Synthetic Biology product orders at Twist Bioscience.

This API supports ordering of various synbio products including:
- **Clonal Genes**: Clonal gene products with vector selection
- **Fragments**: Custom gene fragment synthesis with adapters and order settings
- **High Mass DNA**: Large-scale DNA synthesis orders

## Order Flow
1. **Create Draft**: Create a draft for your selected product type
   - `POST /v1/clonal-genes/drafts`
   - `POST /v1/fragments/drafts`
   - `POST /v1/high-mass-dna/drafts`
2. **Retrieve Draft**: Get draft details with validation results
   - `GET /v1/users/{email}/clonal-genes/drafts/{draft-id}`
   - `GET /v1/users/{email}/fragments/drafts/{draft-id}`
   - `GET /v1/users/{email}/high-mass-dna/drafts/{draft-id}`
3. **Discover Order Settings** (Fragments only):
   - `GET /v1/users/{email}/fragments/order-settings` — catalog of available options
   - Pass desired settings in `orderSettings` when creating or updating the draft
4. **Request Quote**: `POST /v1/quotes/{draft-id}`
5. **Place Order**: `POST /v1/orders/{draft-id}`
   - Returns `salesOrderId` synchronously

## Vectors (Clonal Genes)
Clonal gene items require a vector and insertion site. Use the vectors endpoint
to retrieve vectors available for the user, then reference them by ID when
creating a draft.

## Adapters (Fragments)
Fragments drafts support an `adapters` flag at the draft level. When enabled,
universal adapters are applied to all sequences in the draft, which affects
pricing, scoring, and validation.

## Order Settings (Fragments)
Fragments drafts support configurable order settings (delivery format, buffer,
normalization, capping, shipment) at the draft level. Use the
`GET /v1/users/{email}/fragments/order-settings` catalog endpoint to discover
available options before creating a draft. Pass the chosen values in the
`orderSettings` field when creating the draft.

The catalog returns a list of delivery format options. Each delivery format
contains `sections` that group related settings (e.g. "Additional Materials",
"Production", "Delivery"). Each section contains `components` with selectable
`options`. Use the `attribute` and `value` from each selected option to
populate the `orderSettings` object on the draft.

## Authentication
All endpoints require authentication using the Bearer Token scheme.

If you have an existing JWT: You can reuse this token, simply replace the JWT prefix with the keyword Bearer.

## Available Servers
- **Staging**: `https://api.twistbioscience.com/staging-synbio-intake/`
- **Production**: `https://api.twistbioscience.com/ecommerce-synbio-intake/`
